FIELDS.NAME: PrintWorks Solutions
FIELDS.CONTACT FOR INSPECTION: John Smith, Operations Manager, Phone: (555) 123-4567, Email: john.smith@printworkssolutions.com
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: At PrintWorks Solutions, we specialize in providing high-quality printing and copying services to businesses and individuals. Our operations include digital and offset printing, copying, and finishing services such as binding and lamination. We utilize modern equipment and maintain a preventive maintenance schedule to ensure optimal performance and minimize breakdowns. Our team is trained on equipment usage and hazardous material handling, aligning with safety regulations to create a safe working environment. With a commitment to customer satisfaction, we offer prompt service and flexible solutions tailored to our clients' needs. Our facility is designed with effective ventilation systems to mitigate exposure to any volatile organic compounds (VOCs) that may arise during printing processes. Additionally, we have implemented a robust cybersecurity plan to ensure the protection of customer data, as we offer online ordering options.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Losses occurred between March 1, 2023, and March 15, 2023, due to equipment malfunction resulting in production downtime. The total amount for lost revenue and repair costs was $4,200. The issue has since been resolved, and preventive maintenance procedures have been reinforced to avoid future occurrences.
FIELDS.Combined Single Limit: $1,000,000 combined single limit with a $1,000 deductible
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday: 9 AM to 6 PM; Saturday: 10 AM to 4 PM; Closed Sunday
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class B, Grade 2, Insulated Vault Construction
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Fencing and security personnel on-site during operational hours to enhance safety and security.
